versions.changelog: The test-mode helper (scripts/ie.sh) can now be fully inspected by static security scanners; it behaves the same. The live-mode spending warning and approval rule now sit in one section of SKILL.md, and references/going-live.md opens with the same warning.

Initial release of ask-human-expert.

- Lets users contact real human experts via Instant Expert for written answers or short calls.
- Finds domain experts by description or one specific person by name, company, LinkedIn, or email.
- Starts in a free test mode with fictional experts; no account or payment needed initially.
- Sends paid questions, with buyers only charged on answer or booking and full preview/approval required.
- Includes detailed setup, flow, and pricing instructions.
- Provides simulated responses in test mode and supports full transition to live mode.
